description: Edited excerpts from user-supplied screen recordings; demonstrations are recorded evidence, not a new runtime validation.
source_audio: All three original AAC tracks measured effectively silent (mean/max−91dB); publication clips omit audio.
verification: Publication clips decoded fully and representative frames visually inspected. Crops focus on the demonstrated interaction and camera outputs.

tracking-highlights.mp4.edit: Four chronological 20-second excerpts joined with hard cuts; original camera-only framing retained; resized to 1280 pixels wide, 15 fps; audio removed.
visible_behaviors: Person mask and bounding boxes while holding a smartphone.
Phone mask and bounding box following changes in position and orientation.

visual-question-answering.mp4.edit: Cropped top 450 pixels to remove terminal title and local prompts/paths. Black mask over unused lower-left terminal area hides the beginning of the next unfinished prompt. Resized to 1920 pixels wide, 15 fps; audio removed.
visible_behaviors: Typed question about what is held and assistant answer identifying a black smartphone.
Person segmentation visible beside the terminal.
Typed request to track the phone and phone segmentation visible beside the terminal.

tracking-preview.gif.description: Twelve-second looping visual preview of the four tracked target categories; 480 pixels wide, 8 fps, 96-color palette.

tracking-poster.png.description: Phone tracking with a green segmentation mask and bounding box.

terminal-interaction.mp4.edit: Tight crop preserves the person-tracking request, smartphone question and answer, and phone-tracking request. The original application title, startup commands, local paths, and next unfinished question are outside the crop. Resized to 1600 pixels wide at 15 fps; audio removed.
visible_behaviors: Typed request to track the person in front and assistant confirmation.
Typed question about what is held and assistant answer identifying a black smartphone.
Typed request to track the phone and assistant confirmation.

recording_environment: ROS 2 Jazzy container setup, confirmed by the author.
